Slightly wrong.

Normal strike resolution = first, effects of strikes are
applied. Then, there is the "burn blood for damage" step
(in which damage prevention can be played).

Darkness Within's effect (like that of Wolf Companion, etc
etc) is simultaneous with "apply effects of strikes". But
because you don't burn blood/go to torpor for damage in
that step, you'll move blood for DW before the DW'd vamp
starts suffering the effects of damage.

This is the same reason that blood gained from "steal blood"
effects can be used to heal damage in the same strike
resolution. ("Steal blood" strikes resolve at the same time
as all other normal strikes, but since they aren't damage
they don't have to wait for the damage-handling step.)

Or, short answer: Darkness Within "takes effect" before
damage inflicted in the same strike resolution (ie the first
normal strike resolution in a round) is applied.

Josh
